summary: Valvoline Inc. filed an 8-K to report that it commenced and subsequently priced a $600 million offering of 6.125% senior notes due 2034, upsized from an initial $500 million. Proceeds will repay its senior secured term loan A and partially repay term loan B, with the remainder for general corporate purposes. The company also plans a Credit Facilities Amendment to increase its revolving facility from $475 million to $600 million and extend maturity. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
